## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `HighAvailabilityAndCoordinat`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `high-availability-and-coordination`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **HighAvailabilityAndCoordinat**.
